# csv-parser
> RFC 4180 CSV parser and stringifier with a chunked streaming API, quoted-field/escaped-quote/embedded-newline handling, and opt-in type coercion. Zero runtime dependencies.

An RFC 4180 CSV parser and stringifier for TypeScript/Node. Handles the parts of CSV that trip up naive `split(',')` implementations: quoted fields, escaped `""` quotes, commas and newlines embedded inside quoted fields,

## API
- `CoercedValue`
- `ParseOptions`
- `StringifyOptions`
- `CsvStreamParser`
- `parse`
- `stringify`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
